notes: Read 22 Nov 2026 (see sources; full write-up in research/home-tracking.md). form null = the species’ default form as Serebii shows it (e.g. Vivillon = Meadow, Minior = Red Core, Urshifu = Single Strike, Toxtricity = Amped). gmax: Serebii’s categorised depositable list, Gigantamax box, 34 “Gigantamax Capable” entries (32 species). Toxtricity’s two forms share one Gigantamax look, so Serebii’s Sword & Shield Gigantamax page lists 33 Gigantamax forms. Gigantamax forms are registered in HOME’s Pokédex by depositing a Pokémon with the Gigantamax Factor. noShiny: the 39 “(Not Available)” entries in Serebii’s Shiny Boxes (29 species); Serebii: if a Pokémon doesn’t display, it currently cannot be obtained as Shiny. noShinyGigantamax: 3 more blanks in the categorised list’s shiny Gigantamax box (Melmetal, Urshifu both styles). shinyDoubts: Serebii shows these as shiny-obtainable but other sources cast doubt: unsure. forms: Serebii’s Standard Boxes (1,391 entries for 1,025 species; 196 species with more than one entry, 562 entries), in Serebii’s order; names are Serebii’s with the species name taken off and “(Female)” written “Female”. Not Serebii’s words: Alcremie sweets (from Serebii’s picture names; its text gives only the cream), “Hisuian (Female)” (numerical list says “Sneasel (Female)”, categorised list “Hisuian Sneasel (Female)”), Zygarde “Power Construct (10% Forme)” / “(50% Forme)” (Serebii writes both “Zygarde Power Construct”). formsSerebii keeps Serebii’s exact names and picture codes. Look-alikes Serebii lists separately with the same picture as the default: Greninja Battle Bond, Zygarde Power Construct ×2, Rockruff Own Tempo, Poltchageist Artisan Form, Sinistcha Masterpiece Form; whether HOME’s Pokédex lists them separately: unsure. genderFormSpecies: 102 species where Serebii lists a separate female entry (gender differences, plus Meowstic, Indeedee, Basculegion, Oinkologne whose female is a form). nonDepositable: Serebii’s Undepositable list, 173 forms (96 Mega, 2 Primal, 75 battle-only, held-item or fused forms); label added only where Serebii repeats a name (from its picture names; Tatsugiri’s Curly/Droopy/Stretchy inferred). Names in the data keep Serebii’s straight apostrophes (Farfetch'd, P'au Style); use curly ones when shown on the site.
